title: 500 mapped mnemonic images
changes: Added a Listen to Meaning game with illustrated English choices.
Games now reveal the Japanese word, reading, English meaning, and replayable audio after every answer.
Learners choose when to move to the next question instead of being advanced automatically.
Removed the Picture to Meaning game.
Added a Kaishi Quest character banner behind the main title bar.
Updated mnemonic image frames to show complete landscape artwork without cropping.
Replaced the rectangular title-bar artwork with a responsive transparent character group.
Updated image diagnostics to display complete landscape mnemonic scenes without cropping.
Updated the title artwork to feature only the main boy, girl, and elderly calligraphy master.
Improved auxiliary-page navigation with high-contrast Back to app badges.
Replaced Picture to Reading with Picture plus Kanji to Meaning.
Added the total vocabulary count beside the Mastered statistic.
Added memory links and reference-guided scene images for 100 more high-frequency words.
Made approved the default image status while preserving explicit regeneration flags.
Made image diagnostics load every mapped scene directly from the scene catalogue.
Added SRS Decay Battles, a tower-defence review mode driven by words near their forgetting threshold.
Correct battle reviews damage and push back monsters; mistakes let them advance toward the castle.
Battle answers still reveal the Japanese word, reading, English meaning, and playable audio.
Added four friendly Japanese yōkai with approaching, hurt, and defeated visual states.
Added responsive monster movement, recoil, defeat animations, and reduced-motion support.
Added optional Japanese audio hints with stronger no-hint critical attacks.
Added a battle summary with accuracy, hints, critical hits, weak words, and dojo health.
Added a rolling dashboard count of yōkai defeated during the last 24 hours.
Added 297 reference-guided mnemonic scenes to reach 500 mapped vocabulary images.
Each new scene combines visible pronunciation props with a memorable meaning action.
Marked every new mnemonic image approved by default for immediate study and game use.
